properties.text: THE BLOCK AND TACKLE -- a physics plate drawn by one Figure node.  Spin the wheel over the two knobs: SUPPORTING STRANDS n threads the rope around more sheaves, and the red effort arrow at the hand shrinks to 1/n of the blue weight arrow on the 100 kg load; ROPE PULLED p draws the hand down, and the load rises only p/n -- the two brackets, p beside the hand and h beside the lower block, show how unequal those distances are.  What the tackle saves in force it charges in rope: the two works at the bottom of the readout, F·p in and W·h out, are always the same number.  The rope's dead end is tied to the upper block when n is even and to the lower one when n is odd, picked by n % 2 in the program -- nothing on the plate is a picture.

properties.program:
# THE BLOCK AND TACKLE
#
# Two knobs: how many strands of rope hold the lower block (n), and
# how much rope the hand has pulled through (p).  The load is a fixed
# 100 kg.  Add strands and the red effort arrow shrinks; pull the
# rope and the load rises only p/n -- the rope you save in force you
# pay back in length, and the two works printed at the bottom are
# always the same number.

view -86, -81, 86, 48
align "centre", "middle"

# --- the physics ------------------------------------------------------
N  = clamp(round(n), 1, 6)
g  = 9.80665
m  = 100
W  = m * g
F  = W / N
h  = p / N

# --- the geometry -----------------------------------------------------
# 15 units to the metre; the strands stand dx apart, which makes each
# sheave dx wide, so a rope around one runs straight down both sides.
s   = 15
dx  = 10
r   = dx / 2
x0  = -72
Yc  = 44
Yu  = 34
Yl  = -14 + s * h
Yh  = -20 - s * p
xf  = x0 + N * dx
xl  = x0 + (N - 1) * dx / 2
lw  = 14
lh  = 13
yb  = Yl - r - 7 - lh

# --- the ceiling, hatched ---------------------------------------------
color "#202020"
line -80, Yc, -8, Yc  with width 1.2
width 0.5
repeat 12
  line -78 + 6 * i, Yc, -74 + 6 * i, Yc + 4
end

# --- the two blocks, cheek plates behind their sheaves -----------------
color "#606060"
width 0.6
line x0 + N * dx / 2, Yc, x0 + N * dx / 2, Yu + r + 2
with fill "#e2e2dc"
  rect x0 - 3, Yu - r - 2, N * dx + 6, 2 * r + 4
  rect x0 - 3, Yl - r - 2, (N - 1) * dx + 6, 2 * r + 4
end

# the load, hanging from the lower block, with its rest position ghosted
line xl, Yl - r - 2, xl, yb + lh
rect xl - lw / 2, -14 - r - 7 - lh, lw, lh  with color "#9aa6ab", width 0.45, dash "dot"
rect xl - lw / 2, yb, lw, lh  with color "#202020", fill "#5b4a3a"
text xl, yb + lh / 2, "%.0f kg", m  with color "#f4efe6", font 4.4

# --- the sheaves ------------------------------------------------------
color "#606060"
width 0.5
with fill "#b8b8b0"
  repeat ceil(N / 2)
    circle x0 + (N - 0.5 - 2 * i) * dx, Yu, r - 0.6
  end
  repeat floor(N / 2)
    circle x0 + (N - 1.5 - 2 * i) * dx, Yl, r - 0.6
  end
end
with fill "#606060"
  repeat ceil(N / 2)
    circle x0 + (N - 0.5 - 2 * i) * dx, Yu, 0.7
  end
  repeat floor(N / 2)
    circle x0 + (N - 1.5 - 2 * i) * dx, Yl, 0.7
  end
end

# --- the rope ---------------------------------------------------------
# Every supporting strand runs straight between the blocks; the rope
# goes over the top of each upper sheave and under each lower one.
# Its dead end is tied to the upper block when n is even and to the
# lower one when n is odd -- (N % 2) picks which, no `if`.
color "#8a5a2b"
width 0.9
repeat N
  line x0 + i * dx, Yu, x0 + i * dx, Yl
end
repeat ceil(N / 2)
  arc x0 + (N - 0.5 - 2 * i) * dx, Yu, r, 0, 180
end
repeat floor(N / 2)
  arc x0 + (N - 1.5 - 2 * i) * dx, Yl, r, 180, 360
end
line xf, Yu, xf, Yh
circle x0, Yu + (Yl - Yu) * (N % 2), 1.1  with fill "#8a5a2b"

# --- the hand, and its rest position ------------------------------------
circle xf, -20, 2.4  with color "#9aa6ab", width 0.45, dash "dot"
circle xf, Yh, 2.4  with color "#202020", width 0.5, fill "#e0b48c"

# --- the two forces, drawn to one scale ---------------------------------
# 26 units for the whole weight, so the effort arrow is visibly 1/n
# of the weight arrow.
fs = 26 / W

color "#3a5a9b"
width 0.9
arrowhead 3.4, 3.4
arrow xl, yb - 1, xl, yb - 1 - fs * W
font 4.6
align "left", "middle"
text xl + 2.5, yb - 1 - fs * W / 2, "W"

color "#b03a2e"
arrow xf, Yh - 3, xf, Yh - 3 - fs * F
text xf + 2.5, Yh - 3 - fs * F / 2, "F"

# --- how far each end moved, side by side -------------------------------
color "#202020"
width 0.4
# nothing to measure before the rope moves
if p > 0.001
    xd = xf + 12
    line xd - 1.5, -20, xd + 1.5, -20
    line xd - 1.5, Yh,  xd + 1.5, Yh
    line xd, -20, xd, Yh
    xe = x0 - 8
    line xe - 1.5, -14, xe + 1.5, -14
    line xe - 1.5, Yl,  xe + 1.5, Yl
    line xe, -14, xe, Yl
    text xd + 2, (Yh - 20) / 2, "p"  with font 4.4, align "left", "middle"
    text xe - 2, (Yl - 14) / 2, "h"  with font 4.4, align "right", "middle"
end

# ======================================================================
#  THE READOUT
# ======================================================================
color "#202020"
font 6.6
align "right", "top"
text 84, 46, "Block and tackle"

font 5.4
align "left", "top"
text 12, 30,   "supporting strands  n = %.0f", N
text 12, 22.5, "W = mg = %.0f N", W  with color "#3a5a9b"
text 12, 15,   "F = W / n = %.0f N", F  with color "#b03a2e"
text 12, 5,    "rope pulled  p = %.2f m", p
text 12, -2.5, "load rises  h = p / n = %.2f m", h
text 12, -12.5, "work in   F·p = %.0f J", F * p
text 12, -20,   "work out  W·h = %.0f J", W * h
